basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautiful Bernal Heights two-story single-family home located in a much sought after neighborhood.  This charming home features a living room with fireplace, separate dining room, two bedrooms, one bath, a bonus room downstairs, ideal for home office, oversized one car garage with ample storage space and brand-new stainless-Steel appliances.  It also offers stunning views from the kitchen and the second bedroom. with ample storage space and brand-new stainless-steel appliances.    This home is a walking distance to the vibrant Cortland Avenue shopping area, St. Mary's Park. and Alemany Farmers Market. It is conveniently located close to freeway entrances to the Peninsula, downtown San Francisco and the Eastbay.  Your dream home awaits!
